generator.defaults.cone_interval.note: A Dioon bears one cone a cycle, usually every three or four years (Whitelock 2002, p. 160): every third year.

generator.defaults.cone_life.note: A Dioon's female cone breaks up eight months to about two years after pollination, so last year's is sometimes still there beside this year's (Whitelock 2002, p. 160, 163-164): a year and a half, so it stands closed through its first year and breaks up in its second.

generator.defaults.ripe_lean.note: Dioon edule's female cone stands erect, then leans as it ripens (Whitelock 2002, p. 163-164): thirty degrees.

generator.defaults.cone_seeds.note: Dioon edule's heavy female cone, 25 to 29 cm by 19 to 24 cm (Whitelock 2002, p. 163), shows thirty seeds as it breaks up (estimated).

appearance.note: A Dioon's sporophylls are flattened, woolly scales drawn out to a point, female and male (Whitelock 2002, p. 18-19, 160, 163-164).
